proposed_facts.reason: Canonical cloud and guest consumers support the corrected runtime-parameter mapping. This retains the inherited pointer identity without adding a compiled-layout claim.
The void(void) wrapper calls the generator and reaches its closing brace; StageData places it in on_start. Non-returning terminology was incorrect.
The predicate is stored in the first callback row and returns false without accessing its argument. Shared setup consumes callback3, on_init and gobj_proc, not callback1.

The wrapper supplies selector zero. Independently inspected delegates reset transforms, register eligible joints in the ID table, replace animations, request frame zero, conditionally set animation flags and evaluate the hierarchy.

Only fixed-table selection is guarded by the previous delay being negative. Animation reset and randomized height occur throughout the inactive branch; the active null-lookup return and completion reset are preserved.
Cloud callers integrate the returned velocity toward configured displacement or zero. Braking can cross zero, and target equality does not zero velocity.

The six float argument roles agree with the callers. Division by acceleration is unguarded, and upper-bound comparison precedes lower-bound comparison; operating assumptions are correctly distinguished from validation.
The query passes a null local point to origin lookup. The delegate may set up a parented matrix, and its null-joint branch would dereference that null point.
The strict floating comparison returns false for equality, lower values and unordered comparisons. The qualified matrix-cache side effect accurately replaces blanket purity.

Startup order, cloud joint mapping, qualifying contact latch and consumption are visible in canonical source. Guest selection comes from the fixed five-ID table, independently of delay and height parameters.

contradictions.reason: Accept the cloud-mapping correction and rejection of both rotating-block links. Canonical cloud state, displacement, visibility and collision operations support disappearing clouds, not a rotating-block mechanic. Existing supported structural names and explanations remain retained.

Accept deferral of all five .sdata fact claims and the .sdata link. Four authored switch cases establish behavior, but not compiler-generated table identity, section placement, four emitted addresses or a 16-byte extent.

Accept deferral of all four .sdata2 fact claims and the .sdata2 link. Literal consumers and runtime parameter distinctions are supported; compiled pool allocation, identity, shape and contents are not established by these source expressions.
Accept replacement of the non-returning characterization with an ordinary void-returning stage-start wrapper.

Accept the callback1 installation correction. Table membership is not installation; the actual shared setup does not consume callback1. Its separate dispatcher remains a valid deferred cross-file question.
Accept the delegated-initialization correction: transform reset and animation replacement are distinct from resource replacement, and flagged-joint ID registration is not material-state reset.

Accept both guest corrections: animation reset and height randomization are outside the expiry guard, and child selection uses the fixed table rather than the final parameter fields. The exceptional missing-child branch remains explicit.

Accept both velocity corrections. Braking has no zero-crossing clamp, target equality leaves velocity unchanged before bounds checks, and positive acceleration plus ordered bounds are not checked runtime guarantees.

Accept both query-purity corrections. The local strict predicate has no gameplay transition, but delegated origin lookup may refresh a matrix; unordered comparisons return false and a valid reference joint is required.
